semiconductor_relevance: High — Faeth GmbH specializes in high-purity media supply and wastewater recycling systems, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Faeth GmbH provides advanced system solutions for high-purity media supply and process wastewater recycling, essential for semiconductor fabrication. Their offerings include custom gas and chemical supply systems, as well as turn-key plants, ensuring safe and efficient handling of process media.
capabilities: Chemical Supply Systems (Blending Systems, Acids and Caustics, Solvents)
Gas Supply Systems (Bulk Gases, Special Gases, Compressed Dry Air)

regional_presence.Germany: Faeth GmbH has a significant presence in Germany, where it is headquartered.
regional_presence.Malaysia: The company operates in Malaysia, contributing to its manufacturing capabilities.
regional_presence.Singapore: Faeth GmbH has a strategic presence in Singapore, enhancing its regional support.
regional_presence.China: The company is active in China, catering to the growing semiconductor market there.
